name: Indo Voice
desc:
Welcome to Indo Voice!

Enter a colorful social world where your voice is the center of attention! Indo Voice is our 4th creation, continuing a long tradition of delivering the best social experience. As the pioneer of hangout games in Indonesia since 2014, we have dedicated more than a decade to perfecting the art of play and socialization.

💖 Features & Activities:
- Connect - Meet and chat with friends from all over Indonesia! 🇮🇩
- Voice Chat - Real-time chat for a more realistic experience! 🗣️
- Appreciate - Give & Receive Hearts to share a positive aura!
- Express - Share stories, jokes, or sing your favorite song! 🎶
- Fish & Play - Be on the edge while fishing or playing mini-games! 🎣🎮
- Customize - Look different with exclusive Aura, Trail, Pet, and Tools! ✨
- Vibe - Show off your style with a variety of dance emotes and movements! 🕺

scripts.title: Script Indovoice
scripts.features:
IndoVoice Script is a powerful automation utility designed for players who want to save time while farming resources.

🎣 Auto Fishing

Automatically performs fishing actions so you can farm fish more efficiently with minimal effort.

⛏️ Auto Mining

Automatically helps you mine resources continuously, making it easier to collect materials and progress faster.

⚙️ Features:

• Auto Fishing

• Auto Mining

• Easy-to-use interface

• Designed for a smooth farming experience

Use the script, configure the features you want, and let it handle the repetitive tasks while you enjoy the rest of the game.

scripts.title: Auto Fish No Key
scripts.features:
Script ini mancing otomatis di Indo Voice.

Kamu tinggal ON Auto Fish.

Dia akan lempar pancing, main minigame, lalu tarik ikan otomatis.

Di menu Info kamu bisa lihat rod yang dipakai, status ON/OFF, jumlah ikan, rata-rata waktu per 1 siklus, dan info timeout kalau lagi macet.

Di menu Controls kamu bisa atur kecepatan/tenaga cast dan delay.
